items.stem: Explain in one line why (2³)² is not equal to 2^(3+2).
items.answer: A power of a power multiplies exponents: (2³)² = 2⁶ = 64, whereas 2⁵ = 32.

items.stem: A student writes 2³ × 3² = 6⁵. Show why this is wrong.
items.answer: 2³ × 3² = 8 × 9 = 72, but 6⁵ = 7776. The product law aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ needs the SAME base.
